notes.title: 🌿Virtual Nature – immerse yourself in digital tranquility!🎮
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi Everyone! [/b] 

It’s a [b]unique[/b] experience where the calm of nature meets interactive exploration. My vision was to create a space where anyone can enjoy the peace and harmony of forests, meadows, and lakes – all from the comfort of their screen.
[/p][h3]🍃 What does the game offer?[/h3][list][*][p]Beautiful, soothing environments[/p][/*][*][p]Interactive activities like [b]picking up litter[/b] and caring for nature[/p][/*][*][p]Engaging moments within the virtual landscapes[/p][/*][*][p]A peaceful escape from the rush of everyday life[/p][/*][/list][p]If you love nature, relaxation, or just want to try something fresh and different, [b]Virtual Nature[/b] is made for you. 🌱✨

[i]If you like [b]Virtual Nature[/b], support the project by adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] and sharing it with your friends![/i][/p][p][i]It means a lot for an indie developer, and you’ll be the first to know when the game is released. 🎮💚
[/i][/p][previewyoutube="hI1H4_WVDQo;full"][/previewyoutube]
